name: Surface
description: URL preflight for agents. The preflight_url tool unwraps short links (t.co, bit.ly, lnkd.in, youtu.be), follows redirects, refuses private hosts and unusual ports, and returns the final URL with next: fetch or skip, so an agent can decide before it fetches or opens a link. It never returns the page body. No API key needed; the first 1,000,000 requests each month are free.
author: Surface-ops
